title: CHM (Compiled HTML Help) signature
summary: A CHM file begins with the 4-byte signature 'ITSF' (0x49 0x54 0x53 0x46) followed by version number (3 for CHM). CHM is a Microsoft proprietary format for help files.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: CHM contains compressed HTML, images, and a table of contents.
CHM is used for Windows help files and documentation.
